Name: Bigger Storage (By RafiaBee) Android version
Author: KhaStark
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][b]BiggerStorageAndroidVersion[/b] is an Android-focused adaptation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43013]Bigger Storage by RafiaBee[/url].

The original Bigger Storage expands internal storage beyond the vanilla 36-slot limit and lets you configure capacities for chests, fridges, auto-grabbers, and modded storage types. This Android version keeps that core behavior while adapting the chest interface and transfer handling for the current Android SMAPI environment.

[b]Published with permission from the original author.[/b]

[b]Features[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Configurable storage sizes, including storage types discovered from your save.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Full-screen Android chest interface.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]14 columns x 5 visible chest rows — 70 visible slots per page.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Compact vanilla-style previous/next page arrows in the lower-right chest area.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Small visible arrows with larger touch areas for easier mobile tapping.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Correct page counts even when a chest's backing inventory contains old trailing null slots.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Android-safe item transfer handling.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Compatibility handling for Always Organize Chests [/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Requirements[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]SMAPI 4.1+[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Optional[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Generic Mod Config Menu — lets you change storage sizes in-game.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Installation[/b][/font]
[list=1]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Fully close Stardew Valley and SMAPI.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Delete any older Bigger Storage Android test/patch folder.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Do not keep the original Bigger Storage/Bigger Auto-Grabber installed at the same time.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Extract [b]BiggerStorageAndroidVersion[/b] into your SMAPI Mods folder.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Use Generic Mod Config Menu to set storage sizes, or edit config.json after it is created.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Compatibility / Important notes[/b]
This is a replacement Android version, not an add-on for the original mod. Do [b]not[/b] install both together. It can also conflict with other mods that expand the same vanilla chest capacities.

Always Organize Chests and Android Chest Buttons were used during testing.

If you test another Android game/SMAPI combination and find an issue, please include a fresh SMAPI log after reproducing it.

[b]Credits[/b][/font]
[list]
